added.summary: Marks an atlas's cells as full-colour pictures (item art): ``, rich text's `[icon=]` and every other icon drawn from it keep their own colours, as an `` does, whatever the icon's `color`. Without it the cells stay masks drawn in the icon's `color`, as a CSS `mask-image` over `currentColor` is, so a light scheme's dark ink no longer turns item art into silhouettes once the atlas says what it holds.
